title: NO PASSPORT REQUIRED | UK Garage x House x Punjabi x Bollywood
description:
Turn it up and get ready for a high-energy journey through the best of Punjabi, Bollywood, UK Garage, House, Afro House, Amapiano and Drum & Bass.

This mix blends timeless classics with the hottest new releases, featuring legendary artists like **RDB** alongside today's biggest names including **Raf Saperra**, seamlessly fused together with exclusive edits, mashups and unexpected transitions.
